c006.title: Olympus mju Zoom 130 38-130mm Point and Shoot 35mm Film Camera Tested
c006.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
c006.details: Olympus mju Zoom 130 38-130mm compact 35mm film camera with quartz date. Shutter, flash, autofocus, zoom, film advance and rewind, self-timer, panorama switch and date setting and display were all checked and work. The lens shows no fungus, haze or dust, and the battery compartment has no leakage or corrosion. There is slight dirt and rubbing on the body. It has not been test-shot with film. A strap and a battery used for testing are included.
c006.why: The mju Zoom 130 is a compact 35mm film camera with a 38-130mm zoom lens and a quartz date back.
c006.perfect: Film photographers who want a compact point and shoot with a long zoom range.
c006.exp: A working compact film camera with strap and battery, with light cosmetic wear.
c006.cd: Pre-owned. Shutter, flash, autofocus, zoom, film advance and rewind, self-timer, panorama switch and date checked and working. No fungus, haze or dust in the lens. Slight dirt and rubbing on the body. Not test-shot with film. Strap and battery included. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.

c007.title: Yashica Electro 35 GX 35mm Rangefinder Film Camera 40mm F1.7 Tested
c007.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
c007.details: Yashica Electro 35 GX rangefinder 35mm film camera with a Color-Yashinon DX 40mm F1.7 lens. Shutter, exposure warning lamp, light-dependent warning lamp and shutter speed changes, self-timer, double image focusing, aperture blade movement, film advance, rewind and film counter were all checked and work. The lens has no fungus or haze, and the viewfinder is clear with a normal double image. There is some wear from use, and the light seals have aged, so their light-blocking performance has not been checked. It has not been test-shot with film. The battery type is a 4LR44 with an adapter; no battery is included.
c007.why: The Electro 35 GX is a classic Yashica rangefinder with an automatic-exposure 40mm F1.7 lens.
c007.perfect: Film photographers who like classic rangefinder cameras with a fast lens.
c007.exp: A working rangefinder camera with aged light seals and light wear, as described.
c007.cd: Pre-owned. All main functions checked and working. No fungus or haze in the lens; viewfinder clear. Some wear from use. Light seals have aged and their light-blocking performance has not been checked. Not test-shot with film. No battery included. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
